purpose: Blind test of the Hay River RCM ice rule at two new sites. No retraining, no outcome data.
jam_zone_rule: Every connected channel of every river flowing past the community, from 5 km downstream of the community (or the river mouth if closer) to 5 km upstream of it; community extent = 5th to 95th percentile of OpenStreetMap buildings measured along the river. Gives km 0 to 15.4 at Hay River (training zone km 0 to 15). River geometry only.

hay_river_reference.jam_zone: main/East Channel, km 0 to 15 above Great Slave Lake (training zone)

images.albany_2021_2024: SC30M (30 m ScanSAR) HH+HV GRD: cross-resolution test
images.albany_2025_2026: SCLN (100 m ScanSAR) HH+HV GRD: reported separately, low confidence, outside main scoring

preprocessing: rcm_utils.read_scene: sigma0 from lutSigma, 5x5 speckle window, GCP thin-plate warp to 10 m local UTM grid (identical to Hay River)

classification.open_water: HH35 < -20 dB once melt has started

melt_rule: thawing degree-days since March 1 >= 20 (daily mean air temperature above 0 C)
image_counts_if: it sees at least 30% of the jam zone
ice_cleared: first melt-season image with >= 50% open water in the jam zone; later images not counted

yearly_scoring.Critical: >= 2 counted melt images with jam-zone rubble >= 83.7%

threshold_origin: halfway between Hay River 2022 (flood) and 2023 (no flood); see script 41
flood_likelihood_pct: share of counted melt images at or above 83.7% (NOT a calibrated probability)

one_step_lower_for_each: river more than 3x wider than Hay River
